title: DHA PAE DMS EIDS PMO Data Exchange Services Operations, Modernization, and Development (AOI 02)
noticeType: Solicitation (Commercial Solutions Opening area of interest)
description: Defense Health Agency PAE Digital Medical Solutions, EIDS PMO, seeks commercial solutions for Data Exchange Platform (DxP) operations, sustainment, modernization and development. The DxP processes real-time clinical and operational data exchanged with more than 15 external systems and partners and enables secure, standards-based interoperability among DHA, the Department of Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare partners. The Government wants reliable, secure, continuously available legacy services while modernizing toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, standards-based and AI/ML-ready capabilities. Issued under DHA Commercial Solutions Opening HT003826SC005. No set-aside used.
